# ApkPy documentation

Canonical site: https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/
Project: ApkPy
Purpose: Generate native Android Java, XML and Gradle projects from a supported declarative Python API.
Runtime: Generated APKs do not embed Python.

Core documentation:
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/getting-started/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/tutorial-end-to-end/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/can-apkpy-build-this/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/guides/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/reference/essential/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/api-reference/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/troubleshooting/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/community/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/showcase/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/trust-maturity/

- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/compatibility/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/versions/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/data-core/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/version-1.3.0/
- https://repo-apkpy.pages.dev/benchmark/

Supported client areas:
- Material UI, themes, navigation and responsive layouts
- RecyclerView feeds, pagination, refresh and optimistic mutations
- HTTPS, multipart uploads, WebSockets and Firebase push
- typed SQLite models, asynchronous CRUD, transactions, migrations, encrypted local values and password hashing
- background audio, MediaSession, playlists and Media3 video
- maps, route calculation, continuous and background location
- native Markdown, rich text and expandable trees

Important limits:
- ApkPy does not generate a backend.
- Arbitrary Python packages are not automatically supported.
- Product-specific security, payments, recommendation, moderation and server infrastructure remain application responsibilities.
- The desktop Previewer is not an Android emulator.
- Data Core 1.3.0 does not yet include relations, observable queries or automatic offline synchronization.

Measured Android benchmark (2026-08-17):
- Same 100-note debug app, same Pixel 9 API 35 emulator.
- ApkPy: 5.38 MiB APK, 590 ms median cold start, 46.3 MiB median PSS, 83 physical app-source lines.
- Flet 0.86.5: 25.28 MiB, 1,824 ms, 206.1 MiB, 70 lines.
- BeeWare/Toga 0.5.6: 33.98 MiB, 2,334 ms, 79.7 MiB, 73 lines.
- Kivy 2.3.1 source passed, but Android packaging was blocked by missing Buildozer/python-for-Android and WSL.
- These values describe one small debug app, not every possible application.
- The complete programs, packaging files, raw measurements and reproduction script are public in benchmarks/benchmark-notes.

Showcase verification:
- Four complete app programs are public under examples/showcase.
- Matching historical debug APKs and SHA-256 checksums are linked from the showcase page.
- Those APKs verify the 1.1.0 showcase run; they are not signed current-release binaries.

Support policy:
- GitHub Issues is the current public support channel.
- Separate community forums and starter repositories are deferred until recurring user demand can sustain them.
